metadata_system.name: SELinux Metadata
metadata_system.spec_source: Red Hat SELinux Project; selinux(8); fcontext
metadata_system.description: Mandatory access control labels in 4-component format: user:role:type:level. Stored in security.selinux extended attribute on every file.

attribute.name: SELinux User
attribute.description: SELinux user (system_u, user_u, unconfined_u, root, etc.)

attribute.name: SELinux Role
attribute.description: Role (object_r for files, system_r/staff_r/sysadm_r for processes, unconfined_r)

attribute.name: SELinux Type / Domain
attribute.description: Type for files, domain for processes (httpd_t, ssh_exec_t, var_log_t, etc.)

attribute.name: MLS/MCS Level
attribute.description: Sensitivity:Categories — s0, s0:c0.c1023, etc. (only with MLS/MCS policy)

attribute.name: Object Class
attribute.description: file, dir, lnk_file, chr_file, blk_file, fifo_file, sock_file, fd, etc.

attribute.name: Allowed Access Vector
attribute.description: read, write, execute, getattr, setattr, lock, append, unlink, link, rename, etc.

attribute.name: Default Context (file_contexts)
attribute.description: Pattern from policy specifying default labels
